messages:
marta: Staging alerted on /v1/embeds — sudden increase in 502s after the quant revert merge. Looks like a serializer shape mismatch in the new runtime. Need an expedited hotfix and image pin. Proposing image `gcr.io/redwood/release/embed-serializer-hotfix:2024-08-02-rc1`.

deploybot: Deploy request created (id=dr-4307). Required approvals: oncall, release-manager. Canary suggested: 3m. expedited=true, partial-regions=3.

quan: I saw the stack trace in staging logs — header length differs for short sequences. Patch incoming, will push a fixed build in ~15m.

marta: Can we limit rollout to edge regions first (us-west1, us-east1, eu-west1)? If safe, expand. Rollback policy: immediate rollback if error_rate > 1.2% above baseline for 4m OR p95 increases > 400ms.

lee: Infra +1 for an expedited window. I can hold a 12m midwindow at 19:05 UTC and open the regions. Need release note link and configmap hash before I approve. @release-manager-bot FYI.

release-manager-bot: Release doc stub created: https://docs.redwood.com/releases/2024-08-02-embed-serializer-hotfix (draft). Please add a one-line CV and attach canary evidence. Auto-validate: pending canary snapshot.

marta: Canary ran in staging for 16m post-fix with no errors after the serializer tweak. Grafana snapshot uploaded to the release doc. Changelog line: "embed: serializer header fix post-quant revert; pin image to rc1". Configmap hash: `cfg-0f3a9b`.

deploybot: Approval received from infra (lee). Oncall approval required.

lee: Oncall watching; I give oncall +1. I'll monitor the region rollouts and can trigger rollback.

marta: Paste rollback commands:
```
# quick rollback to last known-good image
kubectl -n inference set image deploy/embed-service embed=gcr.io/redwood/release/embed:2024-07-22
kubectl -n inference rollout status deploy/embed-service
# emergency undo
kubectl -n inference rollout undo deploy/embed-service --to-revision=105
```

ops-bot: Alerting ramp set: 20s. Bound runbook: /runbooks/embed-serializer-revert. Pager rules: if embeddings.error_rate > 1.2% for 4m -> page ops-lead and open incident. Notify channels: #incidents, #eng-releases.

marta: deploybot execute: `deploybot expedite --id dr-4307 --regions us-west1,us-east1,eu-west1 --canary 3m --midwindow 12m --notify #eng-releases,#incidents`

deploybot: Expedited deploy scheduled: dr-4307 -> prod. Canary 3m in us-west1, progressive across listed regions after canary. Midwindow reserved 12m starting 1821122360. Monitors: embeddings.error_rate, embeddings.p95_latency, kvcache.miss. Watchers: lee, quan, marta. Logs tail helper: `gcloud logging read "resource.type=k8s_container AND resource.labels.cluster_name=prod" --limit 200`

quan: I'll tail the runtime logs and watch serializer warnings. If I see header mismatch logs or p95 spike, I'll call rollback.

lee: Oncall ACK. I will trigger the rollback snippet and page #incidents if thresholds breach. Will coordinate with ops-bot for escalation.

marta: Thanks team — once stable I'll publish a short blameless note and attach canary graphs. :white_check_mark:
